1479-5700-5701-6529-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6529-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2060-3286-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2060-3286-4687.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-7803.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1636-3143-6792.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.

When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Mm'menon trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mm'menon trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

240-413-4875.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-413-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

Berta and Animation Module trigger.

1020-2510-2866-4050.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2906-4771-5660.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
2906-4771-5660.description:

Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2191-6747-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 2.

527-542-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1286-6023.description:
Cast Ajani's Chosen by paying its mana cost.
When Ajani's Chosen enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, it triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, Ajani's Chosen's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat step 3.
1286-6023.notes: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop at step 4 that will cause the game to end in a draw if it is not interacted with. It is highly recommended to only begin the combo if you have a way to break it.

Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.

Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

478-804-2821-3088-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-2821-3088-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Xenic Poltergeist.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.

Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.

1775-2488-2968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls at least one creature.
1775-2488-2968.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Ajani's Presence by paying {2}{W}{W}, giving Apex Altisaur and any creature an opponent controls +1/+1 and indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing Apex Altisaur to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Apex Altisaur's second ability triggers, and Toralf triggers if the opposing creature's toughness is less than 0.
Resolve the Toralf trigger, if applicable, dealing damage equal to the excess to any target.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight the indestructible creature the opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

Cast Sun Titan by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it, Radiant Solar and Clone trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fell Stinger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fell Stinger enters the battlefield, its exploit ability, Radiant Solar and Clone trigger.
Resolve the Fell Stinger trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Fell Stinger's second ability triggers, causing target player to draw 2 cards and lose 2 life.
Resolve the Clone trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Trapped Entry" room of Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to discard a card or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Clone trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Sun Titan and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land, or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a legendary 4/4 The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

Frodo's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Frodo attacking each other opponent.

The Frodos trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1-547-2430-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Angler Drake.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling Angler Drake and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Angler Drake from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Angler Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Angler Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Cerulean Wisps targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
 Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Cerulean Wisps, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

1331-1495-2265.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.

If Triskelion has more than 3 +1/+1 counters on it, activate Trislekion by removing all additional counters to deal damage to your choice of targets.
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.
